answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 16 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. The summit multiplier is published, charged in crystal, and sparrow lists each payment. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. A farm of 1360 identities would post 4246 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
